methodological_eligibility.evidence_quote: This paper describes a platform-independent, cloud-based web application that implements energy management in a standardized and user-friendly manner.

stage1.ineligibility_reason: Presents a cloud-based energy management software tool (TIEM) without identifying or characterising any specific EnPI/EnB measurement model; the EnPI reference is incidental to the software's KPI-logging functionality under ISO 50001.

paper_type.evidence_quote: A comprehensive web tool called Totally Integrated Energy Management (TIEM) is developed to implement meaningful energy management.

stage1.notes: Tool/software design paper (TIEM web app). EnPIs appear only as a user-configurable KPI-logging feature; no specific EnPI/EnB model, variables, functional form, or construction approach is presented.
